items.html: And indeed, the aforementioned drop that Aba and Ima cast into the matter and form, for the leaven of the dough, as mentioned, was drawn from the aspect of the externality of the Malchut of Yisrael Saba and the Malchut of Tevuna. And with each and every coupling during the time of gestation, that drop is continually drawn and increased, in such a way that when the days of gestation are complete, the externality of the aforementioned Malchut, all ten of their Sefirot, is finished entering within ZON.
